mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS increase and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP growth rate over two consecutive quarters indicates a strengthening economy, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where the GDP growth rate increases, or if the correlation between GDP growth and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3 percentage points in a month signals an improving labor market, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and confidence increase.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between UNRATE decrease and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production index by more than 1% in a month signals increased economic activity, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as production and corporate earnings grow.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between INDPRO increase and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and a decrease in the unemployment rate signal a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer confidence and spending rise.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 5% in 1 month AND UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the joint effect of HOUST and UNRATE on returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index over two consecutive months indicates inflationary pressure, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate monetary tightening.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the CPI increases, or if the correlation between CPI increase and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 200,000 in a month signals a strong labor market, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and business investment increase.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between PAYEMS increase and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures by more than 1% in a month signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings are expected to decline.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between RSAFS decrease and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
